Constant-rate (Poisson) exposure: P(at least one event in t) = 1 - exp(-f t) (Rausand & Hoyland, System Reliability Theory)
US NRC RG 1.177 - incremental conditional core damage probability = delta CDF x configuration duration (SPEC §12.1, incremental_probability = delta f x t)
US NRC NUREG/CR-5485, Guidelines on Modeling Common-Cause Failures in PRA - CCF as an addition to independent failure, so a joint PFD is not below the product (SPEC §12.2)
tolerance: SPEC §10: objects are compared over the keys given, arrays element by element with equal length; numbers a against e pass when |a - e| <= 1e-9 * |e| (rev .2 §11.10, no absolute floor: an expected 0 accepts only 0); everything else exactly. Cases with restore_replaces: true omit `warnings` (the page may add restored_values).
not_benchmarked: decision fingerprint hash value (§9): approve:true cases treat it as matching; a non-empty foreign fingerprint is assumed not to equal the real one
restored_values warning content (§10) and warnings of cases with restore_replaces

the joint-PFD check at exact equality with the scaled product Q = Π(1 - 1e-9): '<' and '<=' differ only there, below the resolution of double precision; boundary cases keep a margin of at least 1e-10 relative
arrays/objects given in text fields, arrays given as rows, Unicode white space and non-ASCII digits in dates, numbers or list texts, years 0000 and > 9999
number texts producing non-finite values (e.g. '1e400') and JSON numbers in text fields with fractional or exponent forms
